business_scope.primary_industry_name: Digital Webtoon Publishing and Multilingual Chapter Unlocking

meta_jurisdiction_context.sovereign_country_en: United Kingdom (of Great Britain and Northern Ireland)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid - English Common Law with local Gibraltar statute law (entrenched by the Gibraltar Constitution Order 2006)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: UK-Gibraltar Mutual Legal Assistance Treaty (via UK extension)
UK-Gibraltar Taxation Cooperation Agreement (double taxation avoidance arrangement)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Act 2014 (Cap. 100) of Gibraltar, sections 1-30 and Part IV (share capital), Part X (directors and secretary), read with the Income Tax Act 2010 (Qualifying Company / exempt-status regime), the Data Protection Act 2004, and the Beneficial Ownership (Companies) Regulations 2018; the Bermuda Exempted Company template is implemented as a Gibraltar private exempted-company structure with limited liability and non-resident ownership permitted.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Gibraltar Companies House — Registrar of Companies, Gibraltar Financial Services Commission (GFSC)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Incorporation of a Private Company Limited by Shares (Form CO-1), filed together with the Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital and no escrow deposit requirement; share capital may be denominated in GBP, USD or EUR and the subscriber allotment may be satisfied in cash or in kind; the declared paid-up amount is recorded in the statutory capital statement filed at incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION of [COMPANY NAME] (the 'Company'): RESOLVED: (1) The founder's share subscription is accepted; Share Certificates for [NUMBER] ordinary shares are authorized and confirmed fully paid. (2) The registered office at [ADDRESS], Gibraltar is ratified as the statutory registered office. (3) [NAME] is appointed Director, [NAME] is appointed Company Secretary, and [NAME] is appointed Money Laundering Reporting Officer, jointly authorized to open bank accounts, execute contracts, and file statutory returns. (4) The Articles of Association be adopted. (5) The common seal and digital certification procedures be delegated to the Secretary. Carried unanimously.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Gibraltar Companies House (GFSC Company Registry e-portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit up to three proposed company names through the GFSC online portal or by paper; the Registrar verifies uniqueness and restricted-word compliance; obtain the name clearance letter authorizing formal incorporation filings. Notarized consent is required if the name incorporates sensitive terms such as 'Media', 'Group' or 'International'.
required_dossiers: Name clearance application form
Three proposed names in order of preference
Passport copies of the subscriber and proposed directors
Consent letters for sensitive words (if applicable)
Licensed Gibraltar corporate service provider cover letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused for similarity or prohibited words, file a revised list of alternate names within 5 working days to preserve application priority; a formal refusal may be appealed to the Registrar of Companies under section 12 of the Companies Act 2014.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Notarization of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Gibraltar Corporate Service Provider and Notary Public
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association in alignment with the Companies Act 2014 Model Articles; the subscriber executes the Memorandum before a notary public; the corporate service provider countersigns the compliance certificate; director and secretary consent forms are executed simultaneously.
required_dossiers: Memorandum of Association
Articles of Association (Model or bespoke form)
Subscriber declaration of capacity
Notarized passports and proof of residential address of subscriber/directors
Certified copy of the name clearance letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary issues a requisition, correct the signature parties, exhibit the power of attorney, or amend the constitutional clauses and re-execute before the same notary at no additional government fee; full resubmission is permitted without losing the priority date of the name clearance.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Filing and Fee Payment to the Companies Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Gibraltar Companies House — Registrar of Companies (GFSC)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Form CO-1 together with the notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association, registered-office consent, and director/secretary consents; pay the official filing fee by bank transfer or GFSC e-payment; the application is examined for statutory compliance and the Register of Companies is updated accordingly.
required_dossiers: Form CO-1 (Application for Incorporation)
Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
Registered office consent form (Form RO-1)
Consent to act as Director and Secretary (Form CD-1)
Filing fee payment confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a query or rejection notice, correct the discrepant particulars and refile within 5 working days; if rejected on legal grounds, re-submit with amended Articles or a formal legal opinion; expedited 24-hour incorporation is available for an additional fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Statutory Register Set-up
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Gibraltar Companies House (issuance) / Company Secretary (internal administration)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Receive the Certificate of Incorporation, company number and share capital particulars; verify the registered name and incorporation date; issue share certificates and open the register of members, register of directors, register of secretaries, PSC register and charges register; adopt the company seal or its digital equivalent.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation
Memorandum and Articles (registered copy)
Register of Members and Register of Directors
Share certificates
Register of People with Significant Control (beneficial ownership register)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate contains typographical errors, apply to the Registrar for administrative reissuance within 10 working days; if registers are lost or damaged, reconstruct them by statutory declaration of the officers and notify the Registrar accordingly.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Meeting and Corporate Governance Appointments
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors of the Gibraltar Exempted Company
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting or pass the written first board resolution; ratify the allotment of shares to the subscriber, adopt the registered office address, appoint the Director, Company Secretary and Money Laundering Reporting Officer; approve banking resolutions and the opening of a corporate bank account with a Gibraltar bank or EMI.
required_dossiers: Duly executed pro-forma First Board Resolution
Forms of acceptance by Director and Company Secretary
AML/KYC identification pack of all signatories
Bank account opening resolution and signatory mandate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a proposed officer declines appointment, the remaining officers may pass an alternate resolution; if the board loses quorum, the sole or majority shareholder passes a written ordinary resolution to appoint additional directors on the same day.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax, Data Protection and Employer Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Gibraltar Income Tax Office; Gibraltar Regulatory Authority (GRA); Employment and Social Security authorities
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for the company tax reference number and notify the Income Tax Office of Qualifying Company / exempt-status eligibility; register the company as a data controller under the Data Protection Act 2004 (GDPR-aligned) at the GRA; if hiring staff, register as an employer for Social Insurance and establish a payroll scheme; confirm that digital webtoon publishing does not require a sector-specific broadcasting or content license.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of the Certificate of Incorporation
AML/compliance pack and MLRO appointment record
Data controller registration form and payment confirmation
Employer registration form and director identification
Qualifying Company / exempt-status application to the Commissioner of Income Tax
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Income Tax Office rejects the exempt-status application, appeal to the Income Tax Review Board within 30 days; for GRA data-protection queries, amend registration particulars and resubmit within 10 working days; employer registration deficiencies are cured by immediate submission of corrected schedules to the Social Insurance office.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable — digital webtoon publishing is not a scheduled or licensable industry under the Gibraltar Business Licensing regime; the Gibraltar Financial Services Commission confirms that no financial-services license is required for content syndication, and the Gibraltar Regulatory Authority only requires data-controller registration.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No mandatory operating license; voluntary registrations only — Data Controller Registration (Gibraltar Regulatory Authority) and, where monetization contracts are executed, a Gibraltar Copyright Office deposit may be made to evidence catalogue ownership.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environment, Heritage and Climate Change (HM Government of Gibraltar)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt (Category IV — administrative and office-based activity with no industrial process, no manufacturing, no discharge and no land disturbance; no full EIA report or registration tier is required).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater or VOC emission thresholds apply; compliance is limited to the waste-hierarchy duty under the Waste Management (Gibraltar) Regulations, WEEE-compliant disposal of e-waste from IT equipment, and utility/energy-consumption reporting for leased office premises under the Energy Performance of Buildings regime.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Clearance Certificate issued after inspection of the office premises by the Gibraltar Fire and Rescue Service, verifying occupancy load, means of escape and extinguisher provision; structural and electrical-load inspection certificate from a licensed engineer; occupational health clearance under the Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974 as applied in Gibraltar, including workplace risk assessment, first-aid provision and employers' liability insurance before staff onboarding.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Gibraltar Income Tax Office (Commissioner of Income Tax), HM Government of Gibraltar; official portal: https://www.gibraltar.gov.gi/taxation. Corporate registration is handled by the Registrar of Companies, Companies House Gibraltar.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a foreign vehicle (Bermuda Exempted Company) with Gibraltar nexus: (1) file for registration as an overseas company at Companies House Gibraltar if it intends to maintain a branch, place of business or bank account in Gibraltar; (2) submit the Companies House-issued registration details together with a tax registration declaration to the Gibraltar Income Tax Office; (3) obtain a Gibraltar Tax Reference Number (TRN) and, where payroll is present, a Gibraltar Social Security employer number; (4) register with HM Customs of Gibraltar only when physical goods are imported; (5) do not obtain a Gibraltar VAT ID because Gibraltar has no VAT/GST; (6) the company will not normally require UK VAT registration if Apple IAP or Google Play Billing are deemed suppliers under HMRC marketplace rules, but must apply directly to HMRC for UK VAT registration for UK consumer digital supplies if no deemed-supplier arrangement applies.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Gibraltar does not administer a check-the-box election (a US concept) and the Bermuda Exempted Company does not elect Gibraltar tax status by default. The entity is classified as an opaque body corporate under Gibraltar and UK tax law; a transparent classification is possible only if the entity is a partnership or trust under its constitutive documents. Where effective management and control is centralised in Gibraltar, a unilateral residence election may be filed with the Commissioner of Income Tax with prior approval, converting status to Gibraltar tax resident for income tax. Hybrid mismatch outcomes (double deductions) are blocked under UK Finance Act 2016 / Gibraltar Income Tax Act 2010 anti-hybrid rules. No election affects Bermudian exemption, other than maintenance of exempt status by annual government filing.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT/GST/Sales and Use Tax — none in force in Gibraltar; Gibraltar is outside the EU VAT area. HM Customs of Gibraltar collects customs and excise duties on physical goods imported into Gibraltar.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No VAT registration threshold applies because no VAT/GST system exists in Gibraltar. Any person importing goods into Gibraltar must register as an importer with HM Customs of Gibraltar on importation, irrespective of value; alcohol, tobacco, fuel and motor vehicles additionally require excise licensing.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Gibraltar has no real-time fiscal clearance API, e-invoicing clearance or digital stamping mandate; taxpayers must keep proper books and records under the Gibraltar Companies Act and Income Tax Act, and invoices may be issued electronically. For digital webtoon syndication via Apple IAP or Google Play Billing, the store platform is usually the deemed supplier for UK/EU VAT; the Bermuda Exempted Company does not operate a Gibraltar fiscal gateway.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A zero rate is not available in Gibraltar because Gibraltar has no output VAT. If the company later registers for UK VAT or is treated as UK VAT-established, physical export zero-rating under VATA 1994, Schedule 8 requires: (i) a taxable supply by a UK VAT-registered person; (ii) goods removed from the UK to a non-UK destination within three months; (iii) HMRC-prescribed export evidence retained. Offshore B2B services may be zero-rated under Schedule 4A where the business customer belongs outside the UK and the supply is not excluded (reverse charge applies). Pure B2C digital webtoon sales to UK consumers are taxable in the UK (except qualifying e-books at 0% on concession) and Apple IAP / Google Play Billing deemed-supplier rules generally apply.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (C88/SAD Single Administrative Document) for physical merchandise exported from the UK or Gibraltar
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing goods leaving the UK or Gibraltar territory
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank SWIFT MT103 evidencing export proceeds received in the seller's account within 180 days
Commercial invoice, packing list and proof of the foreign buyer's identity and address matching the export declaration
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Although the Bermuda Exempted Company sits outside the Gibraltar VAT net, HMRC and Gibraltar authorities will attack artificial structures intended to defer or avoid UK VAT. Abuse-of-law and UK GAAR principles may recharacterise a scheme that routes digital webtoon-derived revenue through a tax-exempt non-UK entity while UK benefit is received. Consequential penalties include: (i) VAT assessment on full proceeds with default interest; (ii) 100% VAT civil penalty for dishonest evasion (VATA 1994, s 60/61); (iii) criminal prosecution for fraudulent evasion of VAT; (iv) HMRC MTIC/ECSL export-fraud clawback of any previously zero-rated exports plus penalty up to 100%; (v) director disqualification and de-registration under POCA. Export refunds are withheld where the 180-day evidence of remittance requirement is not met.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Bank of England (UK monetary authority) and Gibraltar Financial Services Commission (GFSC) as the Gibraltar-licensed banking regulator; HM Treasury sets financial sanctions and money-laundering regulations. Gibraltar applies the UK's Exchange Control legislation framework which has been repealed and maintains no separate central bank issuance of currency beyond the Gibraltar pound pegged at par to GBP.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The UK and Gibraltar operate a fully liberalised foreign exchange regime under Article 8 of the IMF Articles of Agreement. Both current and capital account transactions are fully convertible with no exchange control restrictions or quantitative limits. Profit remittances and dividend distributions to shareholders are unrestricted, subject to the corporate law solvency test in the Gibraltar Companies Act and adequate documentary compliance under the Economic Substance (Companies) Act 2020. Withholding tax on distributions is nil for Gibraltar tax-resident payers, and no central bank approval certificate or exchange license is required for currency conversion.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There are no statutory export proceeds surrender rules or mandatory conversion ratios for export receipts in UK or Gibraltar. A company may retain export proceeds in any permitted currency, repatriate at its own discretion, and use such funds for trade settlement or reinvestment. Only statistical reporting obligations under the UK Office for National Statistics (ONS) International Trade Surveys and, where applicable, the Gibraltar Companies Act annual financial statement disclosure require accurate recording of export income.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: The Royal Bank of Scotland International Limited (NatWest Gibraltar Branch)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low to medium feasibility. Offshore digital EMI providers (e.g., Wise Business, Revolut Business, Payoneer, or Malta/Lithuania-licensed EMIs) typically reject or heavily restrict onboarding of Bermuda Exempted Companies due to the offshore jurisdiction flag and lack of trailing economic substance in the EMI's regulatory zone. Legal constraints include the EMI's inability to accept inbound wire transfers with certain purpose codes and automatic restriction of high-risk jurisdiction transactions. Gibraltar does not have a domestic EMI licensing regime under PSD2, and UK FCA-regulated EMIs may treat the Gibraltar entity as a third-country offshore company requiring enhanced due diligence. Therefore, a tier-1 Gibraltar commercial bank is recommended as the primary clearing house, with a UK EMI used only as a supplementary treasury conduit for low-value webtoon royalty payments where permissible under the EMI's terms.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Hard physical mandate. Gibraltar tier-1 banks require at least the ultimate beneficial owner, one executive director, and the authorised signatory (if different) to appear in-person at the bank's office or at the Gibraltar branch for a formal KYC interview and signing of account documents. Remote opening is generally unavailable to newly incorporated, non-resident-owned Bermuda Exempted Companies without a prior long-standing relationship with the bank. A confidential introduction by the resident agent or a licensed Gibraltar-regulated introducer may allow a hybrid process, but will still necessitate notarised certified copies of directors' identification and physical witness signatures on the bank forms.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore jurisdiction flag and Bermuda Exempted Company status with no local Gibraltar operating entity or substance marker
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bermuda Certificate of Incorporation, Certificate of Good Standing, registered agent certificate, Certificate of Incumbency, complete UBO register, economic substance filing under the Bermuda Companies Act, a Gibraltar lease/service agreement with supporting invoices, and a business plan detailing the 'managed-and-controlled' functions in Gibraltar.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume, low-ticket digital micro-payment inflows from Apple IAP, Google Play Billing and app-store settlement cycles without a clear transactional trail
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valid Apple Developer Program and Google Play Console agreements, official merchant settlement reports from both platforms, MLS, payment gateway summaries, audited or management revenue reconciliations, and a transaction monitoring policy showing the split of incoming funds between the app stores and the syndication platform.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident, multi-jurisdiction ownership with ultimate beneficial owners residing in a FATF-listed high-risk jurisdiction
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valid passport copies, proof of residential address for every UBO and director, third-party AML screening report, PEP and sanctions sanctions database hits with negative confirmation, notarised source-of-wealth affidavit, and a legal opinion authored by a top-tier commercial law firm opining on the genuine, non-tainted nature of the shareholding.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Capital injection from upstream holding undertakings or affiliated entities with opaque intercompany transfer documentation
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board resolutions authorising the injection, a written equity subscription agreement or shareholder loan facility signed by all parties, intercompany invoice and paid factura details, bank-to-bank SWIFT MT199 verification, source-of-funds bank statements of the remitting entity, and a projected cash-flow and repayment schedule.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax-exempt, tax-transparent or no taxable presence declaration conflicting with the requested Gibraltar banking profile
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Gibraltar Financial Services Commission correspondence confirming dormancy or non-resident status, the Bermuda Economic Substance Declaration, a formal tax opinion concluding that the entity is tax-exempt in Bermuda and not a tax evasion conduit, and evidence of transparent and real commercial substance in Gibraltar such as employee records, annual accounts, and execution of all material commercial contracts.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity and working capital injections should be remitted using standard SWIFT MT103 wire with a clear beneficial-owner narrative 'Capital contribution to [COMPANY NAME] pursuant to board resolution dated ...' and a suitable purpose code under the OECD BPM6/FDI classification, e.g. 'E001 – Equity Capital' or 'E003 – Investment in Own Funds'. The remitting bank must be a regulated financial institution in an FATF-compliant jurisdiction, and the receiving Gibraltar bank will require a pre-delivery SWIFT MT199 from the remitting bank confirming the sender's authority, the form of the injection, and the matching board resolution. Amounts above GBP 50,000 or EUR 100,000 trigger an automatic enhanced due diligence referral; the company should pre-submit a certified UBO register, passport copies, and a notarised declaration of source of wealth to avoid clearing delays.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade settlements for webtoon licensing, creator advances, and distribution royalties should be executed via SWIFT MT103 for single cross-border payments, using SPF (Single European Payment Format) or SEPA Credit Transfer for euro-denominated payments within the EEA. For high-value intellectual property licensing agreements, a commercial irrevocable documentary credit issued under UCP 600 (MT700) can be established, with a deferred-payment feature to enable secure delivery of chapter unlock bundles. Recurring recurring royalty distributions may be automated as batch SWIFT MT104 or via API banking rails such as the UK Faster Payments Service (FPS) and SEPA Instant, provided the payee bank is connected. Each payment narrative must reference the original sales invoice, platform settlement ID and the underlying digital asset contract to maintain a perfect audit trail for HMRC and GFSC reporting.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Plain vanilla FX forwards with tenors up to 2 years
European-style FX options and zero-premium options (collars)
Cross-currency swaps (CCS) for long-term receivables in USD/EUR
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on non-convertible or low-liquidity currencies
Exchange-traded currency futures on regulated exchanges (CME, ICE) for short-term cover

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Bermuda Exempted Company Annual Return and Government Fee
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary of incorporation; return and fee due on or before the anniversary date (30-day advance filing window)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late fee penalty of 10% of annual fee; non-payment for 90 consecutive days exposes the company to administrative strike-off and restoration penalties.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 12 months of branch registration date, annually on the registration anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalty of GBP 50 per day of default; six months of non-filing enables the Registrar to strike off the Gibraltar branch registration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Simultaneously with the Overseas Company Annual Return (anniversary of branch registration)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Criminal offence; fine up to GBP 5,000 and daily default fine of GBP 250 per officer.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 12 months after the financial period end (calendar year for 31 December reporting)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Civil penalties of USD 10,000 plus USD 10,000 per month of continued non-compliance; potential winding-up order.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Gibraltar Annual Income Declaration (Exempted/Non-Resident Status Claim)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 31 August following the tax year end (i.e., within 8 months of 31 December)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty GIP 100 per month; unpaid tax interest at 8% per annum plus 100% penalty for willful default.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Gibraltar small-company audit exemption applies where two of three criteria are met (turnover ≤ GIP 6.5m, balance-sheet total ≤ GIP 3.26m, average employees ≤ 50); Bermuda exempted companies are audit-exempt unless listed, regulated by the Bermuda Monetary Authority, or engaging in a relevant activity with annual revenue above USD 1.2m or assets above USD 10m.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Gibraltar: IFRS as adopted for local companies, with GAPSE for small non-public companies; Bermuda: IFRS, US GAAP or Bermuda GAAP permitted under Companies Act 1981.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The exempted company must keep at its registered office current registers of members, directors and beneficial owners. Under Bermuda law, transfers of shares are recorded within 14 days; under Gibraltar branch rules, an annual UBO confirmation must be delivered with the annual return. Shareholding transfers must be notified to the Gibraltar Registrar within 14 days of amendment.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book of Shareholders' and Directors' Resolutions
Register of Beneficial Owners / UBO Register

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Small Company Gross Income Regime: 1% of qualifying gross income (minimum GBP 350) where annual qualifying gross income does not exceed GBP 500,000; Patent Box: 10% on qualifying patent income (autonomous R&D expenditure ratio >= 75%); no payroll- or property-based tax incentives; webtoon digital-content copyright income qualifies for the patent box only if falling within 'qualifying IP rights' (patents) - ordinarily out of scope.
